slides.title: 5A Framework
bullets: ASK — clinical scenario and PICO question
ACQUIRE — systematic literature search (6S + PRISMA)
APPRAISE — critical appraisal (CASP / RoB 2.0)
APPLY — applicability to our patient in Taiwan
AUDIT — self-evaluation of the process

slides.title: Clinical Scenario
bullets: 68-year-old man with type 2 diabetes and CKD stage 3a
eGFR 52 mL/min/1.73m2, UACR 380 mg/g, on metformin
Nephrology OPD asks: would adding an SGLT2 inhibitor slow renal progression?

slides.title: PICO
bullets: P: adults with type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease
I: SGLT2 inhibitor added to standard care
C: placebo plus standard care
O: composite kidney outcome (eGFR decline, ESKD, renal death)
Type: therapy question -> best design = RCT / SR of RCTs

slides.title: Search Strategy
bullets: PubMed: (SGLT2 inhibitor OR empagliflozin OR dapagliflozin) AND (chronic kidney disease) AND randomized controlled trial
Cochrane Library + ClinicalTrials.gov for ongoing trials
Filters: RCT, English, last 10 years
6S hierarchy checked from summaries downward

slides.title: PRISMA Flow
slides.caption: Screening flow: records identified -> screened -> included (screenshot or generate_prisma_flow.py)

slides.title: Selected Article
bullets: EMPA-KIDNEY: empagliflozin in CKD, NEJM 2023
6609 patients, eGFR 20-45 or 45-90 with albuminuria
Chosen for: population closest to our patient, largest CKD trial

slides.title: Critical Appraisal (RoB 2.0)
bullets: Randomisation: central, allocation concealed — low risk
Blinding: double-blind, placebo-controlled — low risk
Missing data: >99% follow-up complete — low risk
Overall risk of bias: LOW

slides.title: Key Results
bullets: Primary outcome (kidney disease progression or CV death): HR 0.72 (95% CI 0.64 to 0.82)
NNT approximately 28 over 2 years
Consistent across eGFR and albuminuria subgroups
Safety: no excess ketoacidosis or amputation signal

slides.title: Primary Outcome — Forest / KM
slides.caption: Extract from trial PDF via extract_figures.py + fitz clip

slides.title: Applicability to Our Patient
bullets: Our patient matches trial population (eGFR 52, albuminuric)
NHI reimbursement in Taiwan: covered for DM with CKD criteria
Monitor: euglycemic DKA education, sick-day rule, volume status
Shared decision: renal benefit vs GU infection risk

slides.title: Self-Evaluation
bullets: Search took 40 min; PICO refined once after scoping
Next time: run MeSH mapping first to reduce noise
Answerable question, high-quality evidence found and applied
